title: Refresh stale normative quotes in DID/resolver docs
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[did-cid] Refresh stale normative quotes in DID/resolver docs
Spec (13ff882): draft-atwood-jmap-did-00.md L195: "clients and peers SHOULD NOT infer `\"user\"` from `null`"; draft-atwood-jmap-chat-did-00.md L247: "...and the server holds no usable cached DID Document for that DID, the server SHOULD treat the DID as unverified and SHOULD reject any authentication attempt that depends on it. Servers SHOULD NOT silently downgrade ... including by the refresh requirement above. Otherwise, servers MAY continue serving cached entries..."; L289: "Resolution per {{methods}} includes the operation-log integrity check defined by {{DID-PLC}}"; the security bullet "Treat any signature failure as a refresh trigger" was removed.
Code: crate-jmap-did-types/src/capability.rs:116-117; crate-jmap-did-types/src/plc.rs:3; crate-jmap-did-resolver/src/lib.rs:20-21; crate-jmap-did-resolver/src/lib.rs:32-35; crate-jmap-did-resolver/src/lib.rs:171-173; crate-jmap-did-types/tests/did_types.rs:113; crate-jmap-did-resolver/tests/resolver.rs:179; crate-jmap-did-resolver/tests/resolver.rs:219; crate-jmap-did-resolver/tests/resolver.rs:247; crate-jmap-did-resolver/tests/resolver.rs:332; crate-jmap-did-resolver/tests/resolver.rs:351
Now: Doc comments and test oracle comments quote text that was reworded or removed: the keyCustody 'MUST NOT infer'; 'Implementations MUST verify operation-log integrity'; 'MUST treat the DID as unverified and MUST reject'; 'Servers MUST NOT ... proceed with stale cached state'; 'L248: Treat any signature failure as a refresh trigger'. Behaviour still conforms, because the resolver's stricter never-serve-stale policy is permitted by the new MAY.
Change: Update the quoted text and line citations to HEAD. resolver.rs:332 should cite only L243 (the MUST refresh survives), because the L248 bullet is gone. No behaviour change.
Verifier correction: As stated. Also cover the CID quote listed under missed (crate-jmap-filenode-client/tests/integration_download.rs:11,155).
